summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K announcing preliminary results of its issuer tender offer for up to 5% of outstanding common shares, which expired September 4, 2026. Approximately 3,193,088 shares, or 4.58% of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, were validly tendered and not withdrawn. The purchase price per share will be based on net asset value per share as of September 30, 2026, so no fixed price is stated. Final results will be reported after NAV calculation and payment. Watch September 30 NAV, proration risk given below-cap tender, and discount dynamics for this non-listed BDC.
